per_rule.rule: Every S_N value must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N (one‑to‑one join key).
Account_No must be a four‑digit string (e.g., '1026').
ID must match either the 9‑character pattern letter‑7‑digits‑letter or the 7‑character pattern letter‑6‑digits.
JoinDate must be parseable as a datetime in the format 'YYYY‑MM‑DD HH:MM:SS'.
JoinDate must not be in the future relative to today.
JoinDate must be earlier than or equal to LastLogin.
LastLogin must be parseable as a datetime in the format 'YYYY‑MM‑DD HH:MM:SS'.
Subscription_Type must be one of the defined tier names.
SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value.
Flag sentinel placeholder values in SubscriptionFee.
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
Flag sentinel extreme values in AccountBalance.
PreferredLanguage must be one of the supported language names.
Device must be one of the allowed device types.
OS must be one of the canonical operating‑system names.
Flag OS values that are not in the canonical casing.
Flag outlier sentinel value in FeedbackScore.
FeedbackScore1 must be within the normal rating range (1.0 – 5.0).
If Full_Name contains the particle 'bin' or 's/o' (case‑insensitive), Gender must be Male; if it contains 'binte' or 'd/o', Gender must be Female.
If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be null or zero.
S_N must be unique within Acc_Info_dirty (one-to-one join key)
Account_No must be unique within Acc_Info_dirty
Account_No must be a 4-digit code
